name: Supple
storyline:
You play Arin Costello in this management and relationship simulation. You have a week to show off your prowess as an editorial assistant and snag the newly open position of style editor.

Unfortunately this means impressing your ice queen boss Margot Winterbottom, and outwitting your competition, Hugh Chadwick. Or maybe just bribing your boss and sleeping with the enemy. Whatever works to get you that job. And while you're at it, don't forget to make time out to expand your wardrobe to prove just how sexy and stylish you are.
summary: Similar to an interactive sitcom on television, Supple lets you take control of the show's main character. Arin Costello is her name, and she works as an associate editor at the fictitious popular fashion magazine Supple Magazine. The game is centered around relationships, money, shopping, and career advancement. Supple has a unique gameplay experience with over 2000 recorded lines of entertaining dialogue between real-life folks. The objective of the game is to assist Arin in her work, play, and earning points with the boss in order to surpass her coworker Hugh and advance to the position of Style Editor by Friday!
